title: Superquiz Published on August 17
summary: The Sydney Morning Herald and The Age published their respective Superquiz puzzles on Monday, August 17. The puzzles were made available on their respective websites, SMH.com.au and theage.com.au. No further details regarding the content or nature of the puzzles were provided in the coverage.
summary_points: The Sydney Morning Herald published its Superquiz on August 17.
The Age published its Superquiz on August 17.
Both puzzles were available on their respective websites.
The coverage did not include details about the puzzle content.
summary_hi: द सिडनी मॉर्निंग हेराल्ड और द एज ने सोमवार, 17 अगस्त को अपने-अपने सुपरक्विज़ पहेलियाँ प्रकाशित कीं। ये पहेलियाँ क्रमशः SMH.com.au और theage.com.au पर उपलब्ध कराई गईं। कवरेज में पहेलियों की सामग्री या प्रकृति के बारे में कोई अतिरिक्त विवरण नहीं दिया गया था।
